headline: Leidos Reports Third-Quarter Revenue of $4.6 Billion and Raises Guidance
summary: Leidos posted third-quarter revenue of $4.6 billion, up 4% year-over-year, alongside net income of $413 million and increased its full-year guidance.
why: Leidos is a prominent technology, engineering, and science solutions provider serving defense, intelligence, and civil government markets.

impacts.name: Leidos Holdings Inc
impacts.why: Earnings and guidance updates directly impact the valuing of the company's equity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
